title: Dictionaries and Sets
overview:
Dictionaries and sets are useful when you need to store grouped data and quickly check membership.

Learning goals:
- dictionaries
- keys and values
- sets
- membership tests

Why it matters:
Many real programs need to count values, store mappings, and check whether something exists quickly.

Example:
student = {"name": "Aarav", "marks": 90}
print(student["name"])
items = {"apple", "banana"}
print("apple" in items)

Think about this:
What is the difference between a list and a dictionary?
exercises: Create a dictionary with a student name and marks.
Count how many times each word appears in a sentence.
Use a set to remove duplicates from a list.
